catch with a hook verb

classical

prehendō, prehendere

verb, third conjugation

catch or take hold of

With the instrument in the ablative: uncō prehendere. The longer composed example is for when he keeps holding the stick and catches the bar with its curved end.

Examples

  • Bacillō aduncō trānsversārium prehendit.

    He caught / hooked the crossbar with the hooked stick.composed

  • uncō prehendere

    catch with a hookcomposed

See also hook, hook onto, hooked.

SourcesLewis & Short: prehendo

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
